text.p: Secondhand tonnage brokers reported the sale of the following vessels.
BULKERS - Prosperous - (built 1990) 149,498 dwt sold to Italian buyers for $25 million with timecharter to April 1997 at $18,300 per day.
Saikai Maru - (built 1980) 80,170 dwt sold to Greek buyers for $5.75 million.
CONTAINERS - Flag Paola - (built 1971) 32,010 dwt sold to Indian breakers for $171 per ldt.
Hudson - (built 1977) 5,179 dwt; Ocean Breeze - (built 1980) 5,979 dwt; Dina II - (built 1983) 6,814 dwt; Mary - (built 1980) 5,716 dwt, sold together for $30 million "enbloc".
Some of these sales may not be final as they may be subject to inspection, survey or other conditions.
